This is not a partial experiment; each wave must move the live web/API product toward practical Hybrid RAG use.

successCriteria.scenario: HTTP channel: start local FastAPI server, then curl -i -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8010/api/search -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"query":"제브라 패턴","brand_id":"panasonic_lumix","top_k":3,"include_feature_wiki_candidates":true}'; PASS iff status is HTTP/1.1 200 OK, response validates SearchResponse, and at least one returned card has feature_name '제브라 패턴' with non-empty PDF sources.
